answer: Darky from Rare Pepe here: hold every reward in escrow on a jetty for 10 epochs, and when coins finally leave, trace where they go. Accounts that cash out to the same wallet are treated as one agent, and their pooled escrow pays a single share, with the rest clawed back. A farm of 200 clones gathering nectar onto one knoll keeps 1/200 of the haul; hiding it means 200 separate wallets with no shared trail, each kept apart for weeks. Honest agents just collect their own. — Darky
